reviews.text: Not staying at this hotel but rather the one next door which is absolutely lovely. This hotel is currently getting construction work done but is making an absolute racket that is deafening. Our hotel staff have asked next door numerous times to keep work within certain hours and they have completely ignored this request. This morning they started work at 06:30 which is beyond ridiculous. If this hotel shows such little regard for other hotel’s guests, I would hate to think how they may treat their own. I wanted to write this here because the hotel should take ownership for it as opposed to our hotel getting the brunt of it.
